dataset_name: Images and pixel annotations for corrosion segmentation
institution: Pontifícia Universidade Católica do Rio de Janeiro (PUC-Rio)

annotation_statistics.annotation_format: ImageJ binary ROI (.roi) coordinate bounding patches packaged in .tif.zip per image
annotation_statistics.annotation_nature: SPARSE PATCH-LEVEL ANNOTATIONS (Not full instance segmentation masks)

split_information: Official train/validation/test split not found in source archive.
domain_characteristics: Real-world atmospheric corrosion on painted and unpainted structural steel, maritime structures, industrial machinery, and outdoor metal surfaces.
notes: Acquired directly from verified Mendeley Data DOI 10.17632/kcyn4nhv2c.1. Original Labeled images.zip preserved unchanged.
